name: SemanticMapAgent
description: Single LLM call that maps each business scenario to its 3-7 relevant DOM elements, so ScriptGenerationAgent doesn't need the full element list on every call. Overwrites any LLM-hallucinated locator with the authoritative one from dom_elements.json.

inputs.name: comprehension/business_scenarios.json
inputs.description: Scenarios to map — fails fast (MissingInputError) if absent

inputs.name: comprehension/dom_elements.json
inputs.description: Module-scoped (or flat) DOM element list the LLM picks 3-7 relevant elements from

inputs.name: comprehension/modules/{module_id}/dom_intents.json
inputs.description: Module-scoped intent list (action/locator_id/expected_result) used for functional clustering and confidence scoring; absent for BRD-only projects — enrichment is then a graceful no-op

inputs.name: comprehension/modules/{module_id}/interactive/user_flows.json
inputs.description: Recorded interactive-scan flows — a stronger ground-truth clustering signal than keyword overlap when interactive_scan:true

outputs.name: scenario_element_map_path
outputs.description: test_creation/scenario_element_map.json — relevant_elements entries carry intent_id/action/expected_result/cluster/confidence when dom_intents.json was available

outputs.name: test_creation/intents.yaml
outputs.description: Side effect: this module's intents get their source_scenarios backlinked (merge-write — other modules' entries untouched)
